modifications: None. Official compiled ESM artifact copied byte-for-byte; no module.exports rewrite needed in this version.
capabilities: Parse mailbox lists and groups from To/Cc/Bcc text. No Node imports or SMTP transport.
limitations: Parsing is not address validation, identity validation, HTML sanitization or sending.
Caller must cap field length, reject control-character/header injection and validate recipients server-side before sending.
Render name/address as escaped text, never trusted HTML.
